findings.title: Unsupported Sling request API prevents compilation
findings.issue: The remediated current-path initialization invokes request.getRequestPath().getResourcePath(), but this project's SlingHttpServletRequest API does not provide getRequestPath().
findings.evidence: Maven build log /tmp/aem-build.log: SiteHeaderModel.java:[36,79] cannot find symbol method getRequestPath().
findings.cause: The remediation targeted an unavailable request API.
findings.recommendation: Use a request/path API available in the configured AEM SDK (for example the supported request-path-info/resource path accessor), retain public-route normalization, and extend the model unit test. Re-run Auditron; only Build Gate call #2 remains in this run.

findings.title: Public-route current-state defect remediated
findings.evidence: normalizePath plus terminal-route comparison and marksPublicRouteCurrentForInternalAemPath test are present.
findings.recommendation: Keep coverage when changing the supported path accessor.

blocks.p: The original 30-ID ledger remains reconciled in coverage.md. Because compilation failed, no runtime or integration case can progress; the terminal build blocker is BLD-HDR-001, not the remediated AUD-HDR-001.
